nome: Generation: images and video with AI

lado_card.texto: Sound, editing, color, and ethics: the clips you generate here become a finished short film there.

inicio.kicker: CARCKHÉ with AI program · course 1 of 6 · 8 lessons
inicio.titulo: Generation: from storyboard to clip with the Oct/2026 generators
inicio.lead: Which generator to use for each shot, how to write the prompt with sound, why the key image comes before the video, and how to keep the same character across shots. Each lesson ends in a file or a clip that the page itself checks. You generate with whatever tool you have, paid or open.
inicio.capa_alt: A dark film set with a cutting monitor showing the inside of a bakery before dawn; in the background, a blurred spotlight.

numeros.t: generators in the 10/19/2026 table (+ the Sora case)

inicio.aulas_sub: The scene from course 0 continues: "A primeira fornada". Here, Dona Lia's storyboard becomes stills, clips, and a list of prompts; you do the same with yours.

itens: People who took course 0 (Directing) or already generate images with AI.
Creators, teachers, and people who make video for companies.
People who don't use a terminal: everything is done in the browser; lesson 7 uses ComfyUI, which has a window.

blocos.t: What you walk away able to do
itens: Pick the generator based on what the shot needs, with the date of your choice.
Write a video prompt with camera, light, sound, and dialogue.
Generate the key image first and animate from it.
Take your scene's list of prompts to any generator.
2 · Production: from script to finished film
3 · Motion by code with an agent
